videos.title: NASA Found A Planet With Oxygen Just 4 Light-MONTHS Away From Earth
videos.author: BRIGHT SIDE
videos.description: Astronomers continue to explore distant worlds, searching for planets with atmospheres and conditions that could support life. In this video, we examine the idea of a nearby planet with oxygen, how scientists detect atmospheric gases, and whether material from another world could ever reach Earth.
